question: Estimate the average podcast listening time per Indian active listener per week.
idealClarificationQuestions: Podcast = audio shows on Spotify / KUKU FM / Apple Podcasts / YouTube? Audio podcasts only (exclude YouTube video).
Active listener = listened to a podcast in past 30 days? Yes.
Average across all active listeners? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian active podcast listener base × hours/week typical.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian active podcast listeners (any platform, last 30 days): ~25-30M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average podcast listening pattern: 2-3 episodes/week × 25-30 mins each = 1-1.5 hours/week.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Weighted average: ~2-2.5 hours/week per active listener.
